About this product

The Acconet AC-ETH-RJ45-P-CRIMP is a professional crimping tool for terminating RJ45 and RJ11 modular plugs. Its pass-through design allows conductors to be inserted through the connector and out the front, simplifying wire sequence verification and ensuring a reliable connection. This all-in-one tool crimps, strips, and cuts network and telephone cables, making it suitable for creating custom-length Ethernet patch cords and phone lines.
